name: Treasure Factory Co.,LTD.
summary: Treasure Factory Co.,LTD., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the development and operation of reuse stores in Japan. The company's reuse products include unused items and items that have been disposed of by manufacturers, such as clothing, home appliances, furniture, household goods, branded goods, sports and outdoor equipment, musical instruments, and hobby products. It also purchases and sells reuse items through online. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
